facts.text: The hotel sits on Tampa's Riverwalk in the downtown district.
facts.excerpt: Discover a luxury hotel on Tampa's Riverwalk that offers just what you need, exactly when you need it.

facts.text: The hotel is in Tampa's Water Street district, near Benchmark International Arena, the Florida Aquarium and the Straz Center for the Performing Arts.
facts.excerpt: Positioned in the heart of Tampa’s thriving Water Street district, JW Marriott Tampa Water Street places guests at the center of the city, near premier attractions such as Benchmark International Arena, Raymond James Stadium, the Florida Aquarium, and the Straz Center for the Performing Arts.

facts.text: The sixth floor has a rooftop pool deck with two pools and views of Tampa Bay.
facts.excerpt: Downtown Tampa's rooftop pool deck offers a stylish urban oasis featuring two sparkling pools and stunning views of Tampa Bay.

facts.text: Spa by JW has 10 treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge and a rooftop whirlpool spa.
facts.excerpt: Offering spa services, 10 treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge and an exclusive rooftop whirlpool spa, Spa by JW is designed to help you calm, indulge, invigorate and renew.

facts.text: Beacon, on the 27th floor, is a rooftop cocktail bar with panoramic views of the city skyline and waterfront.
facts.excerpt: Sitting on the 27th floor, our rooftop bar in Tampa is Downtown's highest public rooftop cocktail bar and dining destination, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline and waterfront.

facts.text: Driftlight Steakhouse serves fine-aged steaks and locally sourced seafood.
facts.excerpt: Our signature steakhouse in downtown Tampa serves fine-aged steaks and locally sourced seafood in a refreshed, upscale atmosphere for your dining pleasure.

facts.text: Guest rooms have expansive windows and look out over the waterfront and the Water Street neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Featuring breathtaking waterfront views and the Water Street neighborhood, our 519 well-appointed luxury hotel rooms in downtown Tampa boast expansive windows for guests to bask in the Florida sunlight.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a full dining area, a living parlor and the hotel's only private 1,000-square-foot balcony.
facts.excerpt: Complete with a full dining area, living parlor, the hotel’s only private 1,000-square-foot balcony, and more, guests have plenty of space to lounge while enjoying sweeping views of the destination.
